title: Closeout: bwrk next limbo states
body: Implemented explicit next-loop handling for needs_verification and verified work so bwrk next drives near-terminal items through verify and close instead of reporting idle. Evidence bw_evidence_6033620b2d8650e6 and verification bw_verification_d1f0f3d374c59c33 cover the behavior; pnpm check and pnpm test passed on commit 653dc6fb58494e0f28ef40a23f17e66343d10d12.
